records.name: Delivery address change
records.rule: You can change the delivery address until the elves start wrapping your gift. After that, the order cannot be redirected.
records.how: Ask Jingle with your order number, or use My Orders > Change address.

records.name: Returns policy
records.rule: Gifts bought from 1 November can be returned until 31 January.
records.refund: Refunded to the original payment method within 5 working days.

records.name: Last Christmas delivery
records.standard: Order by 18 December for delivery before Christmas
records.express: Order by 22 December for delivery before Christmas (Rudolph Express)
